description: Simulate a past accumulation plan: a fixed amount bought at every month-end in a market basket over a past period chosen by the user, on the open data series (basket price on base 100, prices only: no dividends, costs or exchange-rate conversion). An optional tax scenario applies the supplied rate to a positive total gain at liquidation. Returns the average purchase price, the value at the end and the result, and splits the purchases made when the basket price was ABOVE its bottom-up long-term part (gap > 0) from those made when it was WITHIN OR BELOW it (gap ≤ 0); months without a computed long-term part are counted apart. Same computation as /en/portfolio/accumulation-plan/. Nothing is stored. Markets: US (S&P 500 basket), EU (STOXX Europe 600 basket), JP (Japan basket), CH (Swiss basket). Past data only: it describes, it does not forecast, has no expected return and is not advice; say so to the user. Clients that only expose search and fetch: search "plan: market=US; amount=100; from=2022-01; to=2026-08".

from.description: First purchase month (YYYY-MM); default: the first month with a published basket price.

market.description: Market basket: US (S&P 500), EU (STOXX Europe 600), JP (Japan) or CH (Switzerland).

monthly_amount.description: Amount bought at every month-end, in the basket currency (USD, EUR, JPY or CHF); no exchange-rate conversion.

tax_rate.description: Assumed tax rate as a fraction. Default 0 when tax_residence is given.

tax_residence.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Independent of market and currency.

to.description: Last purchase and valuation month (YYYY-MM); default: the latest month with a published basket price.

name: accumulation_plan
title: MFM accumulation plan simulator (past data)
